remarks: Tucked away in the charming Village of Youngstown, this 3.3-acre residential building lot offers a unique opportunity to create your own private retreat. Located between 353 and 363 Oak Street, the property features a blend of partially cleared land and natural wooded surroundings, giving you the perfect balance of open space and privacy. This lot provides a peaceful, off-the-road setting, ideal for building a custom home surrounded by nature. 400 feet of drainage was installed on the property within the last 3 years. An existing, cleared entrance off Oak Street offers a convenient starting point for a future driveway, making access to your secluded homesite both practical and inviting. NYSDEC has completed a jurisdictional determination identifying regulated freshwater wetlands and/or adjacent areas on the parcel. Buyers should perform their own due diligence regarding intended use and development. An Article 24 permit may be required for regulated activities. Additional documentation is available upon request.
